name: Form to CRM
summary: Turn web form inquiries into worked leads: a request for every submission with its source, a reply due, a stage from new to converted, and spam and not-a-fit kept apart.
description: Every inquiry from a contact, quote or intake form becomes a request linked to a contact, with the form it came from, where the visitor arrived from, when it is needed and a reply due the next day. Requests move from new to converted, not a fit or spam, and a request nobody answered is flagged. Consent and a review date are kept for the data you collect. It is not a form builder for payments, quizzes or file uploads of sensitive documents.
